scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-service-worker.mjs
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only firestore "node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config automation_test/vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.format: prettier --write src backend automation_test scripts/*.mjs scripts/service-worker.js *.ts *.json eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src backend automation_test scripts/*.mjs scripts/service-worker.js *.ts *.json eslint.config.js
scripts.test:workspace: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config automation_test/playwright.workspace.config.ts"
scripts.test:offline: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config automation_test/playwright.offline.config.ts"
scripts.test:api: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config automation_test/vitest.api.config.ts"
